product.name: Loose Fit Tailored Pants
product.description: Loose-fit, tailored pants in soft, woven fabric with a generous but not oversized silhouette. Extended waistband tab with concealed hook-and-bar fastener, zip fly, and pleats at top. Diagonal side pockets, welt back pockets with button, and straight, wide legs with creases.

materialDetails.description: Viscose is a regenerated cellulose fiber commonly made from wood, but the raw material could also consist of other cellulosic materials.

materialDetails.name: Recycled polyester
materialDetails.description: Recycled polyester is polyester made from PET bottles or end-of-life textile waste. The PET bottles or textile waste is mechanically recycled and processed into new yarn.
